original.statement: The source-watcher controller is added to the Flux distribution.

decision.reason: [ev-3ab1e090dc9b] says source-watcher is a controller added to the Flux distribution, so it is part of Flux. A product-relationship subject must name another product that Flux depends on or interacts with, so that family is wrong. The changelog line gives no image repository, CRD, Helm value or other identity that would fit a valid subject family, and every validator was inconclusive. A corrected subject therefore cannot be built from this evidence.
